Gromit executes AI coding tasks with fresh context on each iteration.

It integrates with bd (beads) for task management and uses model escalation
for handling failures efficiently.

Usage:
  gromit [command]

Available Commands:
  add           Add an idea to the backlog
  backlog       View and manage the idea backlog
  board         Show all beads grouped by status
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  decompose     Decompose a plan into bd beads
  help          Help about any command
  init          Initialize gromit in the current project
  install-skill Install the Gromit orchestrator skill for Claude Code
  plan          Create an implementation plan from a spec
  queue         Show processing queue with model assignments
  refine        Refine ideas into structured specs
  retro         Run retrospective analysis
  review        Run a thorough code review
  run           Run the Gromit loop
  status        Show current queue status
  triage        Interactively triage open beads

Flags:
  -c, --config string   Path to config file (default "gromit.yaml")
  -h, --help            help for gromit

Use "gromit [command] --help" for more information about a command.
